skills.name: use-dbterm
skills.description: Inspect database schemas, query data, follow records across declared relationships, or create a saved dbterm connection profile through the local dbterm MCP server. Use for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Turso/LibSQL, and Cloudflare D1 work when an agent needs bounded database context without receiving stored secrets. Database execution is read-only; connection-profile changes require explicit user opt-in.
